audit_items.proof_trace: Both ADL entry points call pre_liquidation_check with whitelist_admin::adl() (= 3), and ensure_has_permission enforces bit-3 via mask = 1u32 << 3 = 8; a cap with only liquidation permission (bit-2, mask=4) yields 4 & 8 = 0 and aborts.
